proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Library class `ExplicitCentralIdempotentConjecture` (lean/QOU/BraidKnot/ExplicitCentralIdempotent.lean) lives over a commutative ring R with `centralIdempotent` an `opaque` element and projectors free elements; nothing ties them to Jucys–Murphy elements or q-contents. The theorem proves only e_λ² = e_λ; the formula, centrality, primitivity, sum-to-identity, cross-λ orthogonality and the bar statements are unencoded. The n = 2 table is wrong: in the 2-dim rep σ = diag(q, −q⁻¹), (q⁻¹σ+1)/(q+q⁻¹) has eigenvalues 2q/(q²+1) and (q²−1)/(q(q²+1)), and (qσ⁻¹−1)/(−q−q⁻¹) has eigenvalues 0 and q (sympy) — neither is idempotent (correct: (σ+q⁻¹)/(q+q⁻¹)); it also uses content −q⁻² against the formula's q⁻², and labels (2) and (1,1) "self-conjugate" (they are conjugate to each other). τ_arch(e_(2,2)·Li₂^q(ζ₆)) is never defined
